finding.bypass: The local WorldSession::HandleGameobjectReportUse resolves a GO from the current map, checks mover/range and directly calls go->AI()->GossipHello(player,false). Unlike ordinary GameObject::Use and Spell::SendLoot, it does not call ScriptMgr::OnGossipHello. The generic script gate added in19 therefore did not protect this alternate path's alive/teleport/phase/visibility/LOS/flags/state checks. Existing source22/group3 conditions still protected class/quest/stage/item ownership, but did not supply those interaction checks.
finding.consequence_limit: For an otherwise eligible owned/bank player in scenario972 at7/8, a direct report-use could dispatch event64 while the player was dead or the chest was invisible/in another phase. This is reproduced at native dispatch level in a fixture, not an observed network exploit or actual client scene. It is a separate gap from missing ordinary loot admission and does not prove an early physical spawn.
finding.native_dispatch: SmartGameObjectAI::GossipHello forwards event64 to its actual SmartScript and returns false. Inherited GossipUse invokes virtual GossipHello. Native GO AI selection first asks the script's GetAI, then falls back to the AIName registry. A GameObjectScript callback alone cannot intercept all those entry points.

Its AI derives from SmartGameObjectAI and overrides only GossipHello: reject null or common ArtifactAcquisition admission failure for248419; otherwise call the native SmartGameObjectAI method with the original player/isUse. Its ordinary script callback uses the same admission. The inherited GossipUse therefore also reaches the guard.

Initialize, reset, update, state changes, event inform and all other SmartAI methods remain inherited. Valid Marksmanship interaction still falls through to original gossip/loot and source22 condition checks; no forced GO deactivation, item/OWN_ITEM grant, extra quest/scenario/group credit, scene/equip override or actor rewrite is added. Unknown entries continue native delegation in the AI wrapper; only248419 is rebound in SQL.
